Ce plugin doit être approuvé par NeoDex: This plugin must be approved by NeoDex to open.
Chaque pierre a sa forme : on les reconn: Each stone has its shape: we recognize them even without the colors.
Clic sur une pierre puis sur sa voisine,: Click on a stone then on its neighbor, or drag
Jeu d'alignement : échange deux pierres: A matching game: swap two neighbouring stones, by click or drag, to line up three or more of the same kind. They vanish, the others fall, and each cascading match multiplies the points. 25 moves per game, a useless swap costs nothing, the board shuffles when stuck, and each stone has its own shape so colour is not needed.
Un échange qui n'aligne rien est annulé: A trade that does not align anything is canceled and costs no money.
